notes.title: AMEDAMA has been majorly updated today!
notes.notes:
[i]Ver.2.0.5  out now on Steam: A new battle mode, ""Yushin’s Infinite Slash,"" has been added! Play as the protagonist Yushin and aim for the highest score![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352424/32660e4d5ae5437f482e233fe865d315401355ad.jpg[/img]


[b]Yushin’s Infinite Slash[/b]
“Yushin’s Infinite Slash” is a battle mode where you aim for a high score by defeating waves of enemies until your HP reaches zero.

After completing the main story, the Yushin statue by the riverbank begins to glow, and you hear a voice calling Yushin to the “dream world.” By approaching the glowing statue and interacting with it, you can enter the dream world and start “Yushin’s Infinite Slash”.

Once the mode begins, you continue battling enemies and progressing to the right on the dream world map until your HP reaches zero. (In the dream world, you become Yushin himself, so possession is not possible.)

During “Yushin’s Infinite Slash”, after defeating powerful enemies, “demons” appear. You can talk to them to spend “Demon Coins” on meals, but the prices are quite high. While in the mode, your regular currency is converted into Demon Coins, which can only be used in the dream world. When you return to the main game, your original currency is restored. If you start “Yushin’s Infinite Slash” again, your current money will be converted into Demon Coins, but previous Demon Coins will not carry over.

Your score increases based on the number of attacks and enemies defeated during the battles, and your final score is recorded when your HP reaches zero. You can view your score history from the Records screen in the menu.

Take on the challenge of “Yushin’s Infinite Slash” and aim for the highest score!

notes.title: AMEDAMA has been majorly updated today!
notes.notes:
[i]Ver.1.3.0  out now on Steam: A new feature, the "Memory Quests" and "Chinchirorin" Mini-Game in the Gambling Den, has been added![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352424/d782c06a016d6ebf589ec5464d216efeb69483a5.jpg[/img]

[b]Memory Quests[/b]
The "Memory Quests" allows players to experience the past memories of key characters they have defeated. After defeating a key character for the first time, seven days will pass, and upon reincarnation, the protagonist Yushin gains the ability to see objects imbued with the lingering thoughts of these characters.

By approaching and interacting with these lingering thoughts scattered across the map, Yushin can enter a world of the character's past memories and begin the quest. During the quest, players experience the memories as the key character themselves, meaning they cannot possess others or use the Kirisame Gaeshi technique unless the character they are inhabiting knows it.

Completing the memory sequence successfully completes the quest, returning the player to the original world. If a player wishes to return to the original world before completing the quest, they can do so from the menu, but they will have to restart the quest from the beginning upon re-entering.

Upon completing the Memory Quest, players will receive a keepsake. Each keepsake obtained will reduce the rate at which your Soul Glow diminishes by 1%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352424/c17003334701ba267bb19f8fdbe10a2b992cd374.png[/img]

[b]"Chinchirorin" Mini-Game in the Gambling Den[/b]
"Chinchirorin" is a mini-game where players roll three dice to determine the outcome. The result is determined by the numbers on the three dice, which dictate the win or loss.
Players can talk to the gambler standing outside the gambling den in the post town, who will allow them to enter and play Chinchirorin.To play, players must set a bet, with a minimum wager of 100 mon. The outcome of the dice roll will either increase or decrease the player's funds according to the wager.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352424/2595ac670f5a4498af30fe558941ca715eeb8ef5.png[/img]

notes.title: AMEDAMA has been majorly updated today!
notes.notes:
[i]v1.2.0  out now on Steam: A new feature, the "RIP Quest" has been added![/i]
It is a new quest system separate from the main story. 
Talk to the ghosts scattered throughout the map, fulfill their wishes, and help them find peace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352424/ccb27e9cce7f41a0ad08594d5a8cce02541e8417.jpg[/img]

[b]About RIP Quest[/b]

In the RIP Quest, players can undertake requests from ghosts lingering around the map who cannot pass on due to various reasons, allowing players to help these ghosts find peace.
As you advance through the main story looking to rescue Yui, Yushin will develop a greater spiritual sense and see more of the ghosts who give RIP Quests. When you discover such a ghost, talk to them and do what it takes so they can rest in peace. 
When you complete an RIP Quest, you will receive a memento. Each memento you obtain will reduce the rate at which your Soul Glow diminishes by 1%. Additionally, RIP Quest events are not affected by the time and date. Even if you reincarnate once or numerous times, your progress will not be reversed. You can proceed through each quest whenever you like.
